business_problem: Techcombank needed to break down data silos and strengthen governance because fragmented banking data was slowing innovation in customer interaction, fraud prevention, and risk management.
solution_summary: Techcombank uses Databricks Data + AI Platform, Delta Lake, Unity Catalog, and Databricks SQL to support personalized banking analytics and governed customer insights. Techcombank needed to break down data silos and strengthen governance because fragmented banking data was slowing innovation in customer interaction, fraud prevention, and risk management. In practice, the implementation stores or organizes core datasets in Delta Lake, governs access and lineage with Unity Catalog, runs transformation or AI logic on Databricks Data + AI Platform, and delivers outputs through Databricks SQL. Customer, product, and interaction data are consolidated into Delta Lake; Databricks Data + AI Platform applies analytics or model logic; results are surfaced through Databricks SQL. The case study reports Ushering personalized banking for millions of customers 1,000+, showing measurable improvement after the rollout.
business_outcome: Techcombank reported Ushering personalized banking for millions of customers 1,000+, improving personalized banking analytics and governed customer insights with measurable gains in customer experience, risk reduction, scalability, and productivity improvement.
metrics: Ushering personalized banking for millions of customers 1,000+
